title: Déjà vu, but billable
why_read: A small hackathon-style side project building local semantic search over an appliance repair technician's own job history, interesting as an applied RAG use case but modest in scope.
analysis: CaseJog is described as a local tool that lets a repair technician search their own past repair cases by symptom description, using semantic matching rather than exact keyword search, with data staying entirely on the technician's machine. This is a reasonably concrete and relatable example of applying retrieval techniques to a narrow professional niche, which can be a good illustration of practical RAG design for small, personal datasets. It's a hackathon submission rather than a polished product or research result, so the technical depth is limited to a single use case. Still, the privacy-preserving, local-only design choice is a sensible and worth-noting detail for similar small-scale applications.
